text:
maya: Quick kickoff for CloudAtlas marketplace launch content. Goal: publish a small benchmark story, 1-page developer quickstart, and a webinar within the same week. Need clear owners + lead routing rules.

rachel: For the benchmark let's make it story-first: 3 short use cases (in-app chat, doc Q&A, semantic search). Benchmarks = real request traces (anonymized) + 95th/99th latency & cost per 10k tokens. Keep visuals simple: 2 charts + a table CSV.

nate: Developer quickstart should be <1hr to run. Include a repo link, Docker command, and a mapping file for model names. We should call out "works on Hosted and Dedicated" and show the minimal config differences.

sam: Webinar ops: 25m demo (nate + rachel), 20m partner/customer panel, 10m live q. Target date: Wed May 3, dry-run Tue May 2. I'll tentatively block those and ping Jenna for the customer slot.

maya: Ownership: Rachel = benchmark write + charts; Nate = quickstart + repo; Sam = webinar logistics + registration page; Maya = partner comms & copy. Agreed?

rachel: Agreed. Bench timeline: draft by Fri EOD, final by next Tue. I'll produce CSV export with these columns: workload, model_variant, avg_latency_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, token_count, cost_usd.

nate: Repo layout note in quickstart: add `examples/marketplace` and include a small Dockerfile and `run.sh`. Also include a troubleshooting FAQ line about cold starts.

maya: Tracking params: use UTMs and a partner hidden field. Proposed utm pattern: `utm_source=cloudatlas&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cloudatlas-launch&utm_content={asset}` where {asset}=benchmark|quickstart|webinar. Also add form field `partner=cloudatlas`.

sam: Lead routing rule draft: if form.partner == 'cloudatlas' -> route to SFDC queue "Marketplace Partners"; if lead.score >= 70 -> tag "sales-priority" and notify AE channel; else go to SDR pool. I'll add the exact SFDC queue names & field mapping in the doc.

rachel: Messaging A/B ideas for listing headers: A) "Deploy inference that stays fast and predictable" B) "Cut inference costs without sacrificing SLAs" — prefer A for developer-facing quickstart and B for partner market listing.

maya: Let's A/B both across marketplace listing copy and the webinar subject line. Sam, ensure registration form captures `utm_content` so we can tie performance back to asset.

sam: Done. Also adding `?ref=cloudatlas` short param for email templates.

analytics-bot: New analytics note: recommend tracking `download:benchmark_csv` event and `repo:quickstart_clone`. Will surface in weekly partner dashboard.

rachel: One more: include a short "When to use Dedicated vs Hosted" FAQ in benchmark (3 bullets + one-sentence decision rule). I'll draft it.

maya: Perfect. I'll make a /drive folder `cloudatlas-launch` and add deadlines. Sam, tag the calendar invite when you lock the date.

sam: Will do. Pls ping me if dates shift.

nate: I'll prep the demo scripts and a tiny perf harness for the webinar so we can show repeatable numbers.

maya: Awesome. Closing notes: add label `partner:cloudatlas` to all assets, push final copy to the partner board, and we'll review in dry run. :thumbsup:
